}

    const stems = [
      {char:"甲", yomi:"きのえ", element:"木", yinYang:"陽"},
      {char:"乙", yomi:"きのと", element:"木", yinYang:"陰"},
      {char:"丙", yomi:"ひのえ", element:"火", yinYang:"陽"},
      {char:"丁", yomi:"ひのと", element:"火", yinYang:"陰"},
      {char:"戊", yomi:"つちのえ", element:"土", yinYang:"陽"},
      {char:"己", yomi:"つちのと", element:"土", yinYang:"陰"},

      {char:"辛", yomi:"かのと", element:"金", yinYang:"陰"},
      {char:"壬", yomi:"みずのえ", element:"水", yinYang:"陽"},
      {char:"癸", yomi:"みずのと", element:"水", yinYang:"陰"}
    ];

    const branches = [
      {char:"子", yomi:"ね", theme:"始動", desc:"小さな兆しを見つけ、最初の一歩を形にする力。"},
      {char:"丑", yomi:"うし", theme:"蓄積", desc:"急がず、足元を固めながら力を蓄える時。"},
      {char:"寅", yomi:"とら", theme:"前進", desc:"眠っていた力を外へ向け、動き出す勢い。"},
      {char:"卯", yomi:"う", theme:"伸長", desc:"人や物事との関係が広がり、成長が加速する時。"},
      {char:"辰", yomi:"たつ", theme:"変化", desc:"形が変わることで、新しい可能性が立ち上がる時。"},
      {char:"巳", yomi:"み", theme:"熟考", desc:"表面よりも内側を見つめ、知恵を深める時。"},
      {char:"午", yomi:"うま", theme:"発揮", desc:"力を外に出し、明るく存在感を示す時。"},
      {char:"未", yomi:"ひつじ", theme:"調整", desc:"整え、育て、次の段階へつなぐための時間。"},
      {char:"申", yomi:"さる", theme:"工夫", desc:"知恵と機転を使い、状況を柔軟に動かす時。"},
      {char:"酉", yomi:"とり", theme:"収穫", desc:"積み重ねたものをまとめ、成果として受け取る時。"},
      {char:"戌", yomi:"いぬ", theme:"守成", desc:"大切なものを守り、不要なものを手放す時。"},
      {char:"亥", yomi:"い", theme:"準備", desc:"次の始まりに向け、静かに力を満たす時。"}
    ];

    const stemMeaning = {
      "甲":"まっすぐ伸びる大樹のように、自分の軸を立てる。",
      "乙":"草花のように、しなやかに環境へ適応する。",
      "丙":"太陽のように、明るさと情熱を外へ届ける。",
      "丁":"灯火のように、小さくても確かな光を守る。",
      "戊":"山のように、動じず土台を支える。",
      "己":"畑の土のように、受け止め育てる。",
      "庚":"鉄のように、決断し不要なものを削ぎ落とす。",
      "辛":"宝石のように、磨き上げ本質を際立たせる。",
      "壬":"大河のように、広く流れ変化を受け入れる。",
      "癸":"雨露のように、静かに浸透し命を潤す。"
    };

    const colors = {
      "木":"#4f7658",
      "火":"#a65343",
      "土":"#5f5546",
      "金":"#c09a43",
      "水":"#476a7b"
    };

    const adviceByElement = {
      "木":"今日は「育てたいもの」を一つ決めて、小さく手を入れてみましょう。",
      "火":"気持ちは内に留めず、言葉や行動として一度外へ出してみましょう。",
      "土":"新しいことを増やすより、今あるものを整えることが力になります。",
      "金":"迷っていることがあれば、基準を一つ決めて選び取ってみましょう。",
      "水":"流れを変えようと力むより、状況を観察して柔軟に動くのが吉です。"
    };

    // 仮データ。以前作成した正式な対応表が手元にあれば、ここだけ差し替えれば反映できます。
    const luckyByBranch = {
      "子":{playground:"ブランコ",rec:"連想ゲーム",word:"はじまり",action:"小さな一歩を始める"},
      "丑":{playground:"砂場",rec:"積み木・タワー遊び",word:"こつこつ",action:"一つずつ積み上げる"},
      "寅":{playground:"うんてい",rec:"ジェスチャーゲーム",word:"前へ",action:"思い切って動いてみる"},
      "卯":{playground:"すべり台",rec:"ペアトーク",word:"のびる",action:"人とのつながりを広げる"},
      "辰":{playground:"ジャングルジム",rec:"即興お絵描き",word:"変化",action:"いつもと違う方法を試す"},
      "巳":{playground:"鉄棒",rec:"なぞなぞ",word:"深める",action:"一度立ち止まって考える"},
      "午":{playground:"ターザンロープ",rec:"歌・リズム遊び",word:"発揮",action:"得意なことを表に出す"},
      "未":{playground:"シーソー",rec:"協力ゲーム",word:"整える",action:"身の回りを一つ整える"},
      "申":{playground:"複合遊具",rec:"クイズ",word:"工夫",action:"別のやり方を考える"},
      "酉":{playground:"回転遊具",rec:"ビンゴ",word:"実り",action:"今日できたことを数える"},
      "戌":{playground:"平均台",rec:"思い出トーク",word:"守る",action:"大切なものを確認する"},
      "亥":{playground:"スプリング遊具",rec:"静かなカードゲーム",word:"備える",action:"次に向けて準備する"}
    };

    const luckyColorByElement = {
      "木":"緑",
      "火":"赤・朱",
      "土":"茶・黄土",
      "金":"金・黄色",
      "水":"青・紺"
    };

    const cardTextData = Array.isArray(window.FORTUNE_CARDS) ? window.FORTUNE_CARDS : [];

    if(cardTextData.length !== 60){
      console.warn("FORTUNE_CARDS は60枚を想定しています。現在:", cardTextData.length);
    }

    const allKanshi = Array.from({length:60}, (_, i) => {
      const stem = stems[i % 10];
      const branch = branches[i % 12];
      const text = cardTextData[i] || {};
      const defaultKanshi = stem.char + branch.char;
      const cardName = text.cardName || "未設定";
      return {
        no:i+1,
        name:defaultKanshi,
        yomi:stem.yomi + branch.yomi,
        stem,
        branch,
        cardName,
        displayName:(text.kanshi || defaultKanshi) + "《" + cardName + "》",
        dailyHint:text.dailyHint || "今日一日の示唆が未設定です。",
        question:text.question || "今日の問いが未設定です。",
        luckyColor:text.luckyColor || "未設定",
        luckyItem:text.luckyItem || "未設定",
        luckyPlayground:text.luckyPlayground || "未設定",
        luckyRec:text.luckyRec || "未設定",
        reason:text.reason || ""
      };
    });

    const card = document.getElementById("card");
    const drawBtn = document.getElementById("drawBtn");
    const resetBtn = document.getElementById("resetBtn");
    const result = {classList:{remove:function(){},add:function(){}}};
    let drawing = false;
    let currentMainCard = null;
    let companionCardData = null;
    let companionDrawn = false;
    let showingCompanion = false;
    const companionCards = Array.isArray(window.COMPANION_CARDS) ? window.COMPANION_CARDS : [];

    function renderCard(data, onImageReady){
      currentMainCard = data;
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--element-color", colors[data.stem.element]);

      document.getElementById("infoKanshi").textContent = data.displayName;
      document.getElementById("infoYomi").textContent = data.yomi;
      document.getElementById("infoStem").textContent = data.stem.char;
      document.getElementById("infoBranch").textContent = data.branch.char;
      document.getElementById("infoElement").textContent = data.stem.element;
      document.getElementById("infoYinYang").textContent = data.stem.yinYang;

      document.getElementById("dailyHint").textContent = data.dailyHint;
      document.getElementById("todayQuestion").textContent = data.question;

      document.getElementById("luckyColor").textContent = data.luckyColor;
      document.getElementById("luckyItem").textContent = data.luckyItem;
      document.getElementById("luckyPlayground").textContent = data.luckyPlayground;
      document.getElementById("luckyRec").textContent = data.luckyRec;

      loadCardImage(data.no, onImageReady);
    }



    function makePlaceholderDataUrl(label, no){
      const n = String(no).padStart(2,"0");
      const svg =
        `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="910" height="550" viewBox="0 0 910 550">
          <rect width="910" height="550" rx="36" fill="#e7dbc8"/>
          <rect x="26" y="26" width="858" height="498" rx="28" fill="none" stroke="#8b7b66" stroke-width="3"/>
          <text x="455" y="245" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="58" fill="#40382f">${label}</text>
          <text x="455" y="330" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="76" font-weight="700" fill="#40382f">NO.${n}</text>
        </svg>`;
      return "data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(svg);
    }

    function loadImageInto(imgEl, folder, no, onReady){
      const baseName = String(no).padStart(2,"0");
      const candidates = [
        `images/${folder}/${baseName}.webp`,
        `images/${folder}/${baseName}.png`,
        `images/${folder}/${baseName}.jpg`,
        `images/${folder}/${baseName}.jpeg`
      ];
      let index = 0;

      function tryNext(){
        if(index >= candidates.length){
          const label = folder === "nakama" ? "仲間カード" : "六十干支カード";
          imgEl.src = makePlaceholderDataUrl(label, no);
          imgEl.onload = function(){
            if(onReady) onReady(true);
          };
          return;
        }
        imgEl.onload = function(){
          if(onReady) onReady(true);
        };
        imgEl.onerror = function(){
          index++;
          tryNext();
        };
        imgEl.src = resolveAsset(candidates[index]);
      }
      tryNext();
    }


    let catalogMode = null; // "fortune" | "companion"
    let catalogIndex = 0;
    let catalogAnimating = false;
    let catalogTouchStartX = null;
    let catalogTouchStartY = null;

    function handleHomeCardTap(){
      const resultScreen = document.getElementById("resultScreen");
      const yearScreen = document.getElementById("yearPickerScreen");
      const creatorScreen = document.getElementById("creatorScreen");
      const catalogScreen = document.getElementById("catalogScreen");
      if(
        (resultScreen && resultScreen.classList.contains("show")) ||
        (yearScreen && yearScreen.classList.contains("show")) ||
        (creatorScreen && creatorScreen.classList.contains("show")) ||
        (catalogScreen && catalogScreen.classList.contains("show"))
      ) return;
      draw();
    }

    function toggleNavMenu(){
      const menu = document.getElementById("navMenu");
      const backdrop = document.getElementById("navMenuBackdrop");
      const willOpen = !menu.classList.contains("show");
      if(willOpen){
        menu.classList.add("show");
        menu.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
        backdrop.hidden = false;
      }else{
        closeNavMenu();
      }
    }

    function closeNavMenu(){
      const menu = document.getElementById("navMenu");
      const backdrop = document.getElementById("navMenuBackdrop");
      if(menu){
        menu.classList.remove("show");
        menu.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
      }
      if(backdrop) backdrop.hidden = true;
    }

    function hideMainResultForSubpage(){
      const resultScreen = document.getElementById("resultScreen");
      const yearPicker = document.getElementById("yearPickerScreen");
      if(resultScreen) resultScreen.classList.remove("show");
      if(yearPicker) yearPicker.classList.remove("show");
    }

    function loadCreatorContent(){
      const data = (window.CREATOR_DATA && typeof window.CREATOR_DATA === "object")
        ? window.CREATOR_DATA
        : {};
      const title = document.getElementById("creatorTitle");
      const comment = document.getElementById("creatorComment");
      const img = document.getElementById("creatorImage");
      const fallback = document.getElementById("creatorImageFallback");

      if(title) title.textContent = data.title || "製作者";
      if(comment) comment.textContent = data.comment || "ここに製作者からのコメントを表示できます。";

      if(img){
        const candidates = [
          data.image || "",
          "images/common/creator.webp",
          "images/common/creator.png",
          "images/common/creator.jpg",
          "images/common/creator.jpeg"
        ].filter(Boolean);
        let i = 0;
        function next(){
          if(i >= candidates.length){
            img.hidden = true;
            if(fallback) fallback.style.display = "flex";
            return;
          }
          img.onload = function(){
            img.hidden = false;
            if(fallback) fallback.style.display = "none";
          };
          img.onerror = function(){
            i++;
            next();
          };
          img.src = resolveAsset(candidates[i]);
        }
        next();
      }
    }

    function openCreatorPage(){
      closeNavMenu();
      hideMainResultForSubpage();
      const catalog = document.getElementById("catalogScreen");
      if(catalog) catalog.classList.remove("show");
      const shortcut = document.getElementById("shortcutScreen");
      if(shortcut){
        shortcut.classList.remove("show");
        shortcut.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
      }
      const screen = document.getElementById("creatorScreen");
      if(screen){
        screen.classList.add("show");
        screen.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
      }
      document.body.classList.add("subpage-mode");
      loadCreatorContent();
    }


    let deferredInstallPrompt = null;

    window.addEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      deferredInstallPrompt = event;
    });

    function isStandalonePwa(){
      return window.matchMedia("(display-mode: standalone)").matches
        || window.navigator.standalone === true;
    }

    function showShortcutGuide(title, htmlText){
      const guide = document.getElementById("shortcutInstallGuide");
      const titleEl = document.getElementById("shortcutGuideTitle");
      const textEl = document.getElementById("shortcutGuideText");
      if(titleEl && title) titleEl.textContent = title;
      if(textEl && htmlText) textEl.innerHTML = htmlText;
      if(guide) guide.classList.add("show");
    }

    function openShortcutPage(){
      closeNavMenu();
      hideMainResultForSubpage();

      const creator = document.getElementById("creatorScreen");
      const catalog = document.getElementById("catalogScreen");
      if(creator){
        creator.classList.remove("show");
        creator.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
      }
      if(catalog){
        catalog.classList.remove("show");
        catalog.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
      }

      const screen = document.getElementById("shortcutScreen");
      if(screen){
        screen.classList.add("show");
        screen.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
      }
      document.body.classList.add("subpage-mode");

      const guide = document.getElementById("shortcutInstallGuide");
      if(guide) guide.classList.remove("show");

      if(isStandalonePwa()){
        showShortcutGuide(
          "ホーム画面から起動しています",
          "このChronoloopはすでにホーム画面からアプリのように起動しています。"
        );
      }
    }

    async function requestPwaInstall(){
      if(isStandalonePwa()){
        showShortcutGuide(
          "すでにホーム画面から起動しています",
          "このChronoloopはすでにPWAとして起動しています。追加の操作は不要です。"
        );
        return;
      }

      if(deferredInstallPrompt){
        deferredInstallPrompt.prompt();
        const result = await deferredInstallPrompt.userChoice;
        deferredInstallPrompt = null;

        if(result && result.outcome === "accepted"){
          showShortcutGuide(
            "ホーム画面への追加を開始しました",
            "画面の案内に従って追加してください。"
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      showShortcutGuide(
        "iPhoneでホーム画面に追加する方法",
        'iPhoneでは、Webページ側から自動でホーム画面へ追加することはできません。'
        + 'Safariの「共有」ボタンを押し、'
        + '「ホーム画面に追加」→「追加」の順に操作してください。'
      );
    }

    function openCardCatalog(mode){
      closeNavMenu();
      hideMainResultForSubpage();
      const creator = document.getElementById("creatorScreen");
      if(creator) creator.classList.remove("show");
      const shortcut = document.getElementById("shortcutScreen");
      if(shortcut){
        shortcut.classList.remove("show");
        shortcut.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
      }

      catalogMode = mode === "companion" ? "companion" : "fortune";
      catalogIndex = 0;
      catalogAnimating = false;

      const screen = document.getElementById("catalogScreen");
      if(screen){
        screen.classList.add("show");
        screen.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
      }
      document.body.classList.add("subpage-mode");
      bindCatalogGestures();
      renderCatalogCard(false, 1);
    }

    function returnHomeFromSubpage(){
      closeNavMenu();
      const creator = document.getElementById("creatorScreen");
      const catalog = document.getElementById("catalogScreen");
      const shortcut = document.getElementById("shortcutScreen");
      if(creator){
        creator.classList.remove("show");
        creator.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
      }
      if(catalog){
        catalog.classList.remove("show");
        catalog.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
      }
      if(shortcut){
        shortcut.classList.remove("show");
        shortcut.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
      }
      document.body.classList.remove("subpage-mode");
      catalogMode = null;
      returnToStart();
    }

    function catalogCount(){
      if(catalogMode === "companion"){
        return companionCards.length || 1;
      }
      return allKanshi.length || 60;
    }

    function normalizedCatalogIndex(index){
      const count = catalogCount();
      return ((index % count) + count) % count;
    }

    function catalogTapNavigate(direction,event){
      if(event){
        event.stopPropagation();
        event.preventDefault();
      }
      navigateCatalog(direction);
    }

    function navigateCatalog(direction){
      if(catalogAnimating) return;
      catalogIndex = normalizedCatalogIndex(catalogIndex + (direction > 0 ? 1 : -1));
      renderCatalogCard(true, direction);
    }

    function renderCatalogCard(animate, direction){
      const img = document.getElementById("catalogCardImage");
      const counter = document.getElementById("catalogCounter");
      const typeLabel = document.getElementById("catalogTypeLabel");
      const text = document.getElementById("catalogText");
      const scroller = document.getElementById("catalogScroll");
      if(!img || !text) return;

      const count = catalogCount();
      const no = catalogIndex + 1;
      if(counter) counter.textContent = "No." + String(no).padStart(2,"0") + " / " + count;
      if(typeLabel) typeLabel.textContent = catalogMode === "companion" ? "仲間カード" : "占いカード";
      if(scroller) scroller.scrollTop = 0;

      function setText(){
        if(catalogMode === "companion"){
          const data = companionCards[catalogIndex] || {};
          text.innerHTML =
            '<div class="companion-catalog-line"></div>' +
            '<div class="companion-catalog-name"></div>' +
            '<div class="companion-catalog-effect"></div>';
          text.querySelector(".companion-catalog-line").textContent = data.line || "";
          text.querySelector(".companion-catalog-name").textContent = data.name || ("仲間カード " + String(no).padStart(2,"0"));
          text.querySelector(".companion-catalog-effect").textContent = data.effect || "";
        }else{
          const data = allKanshi[catalogIndex];
          text.innerHTML =
            '<div class="kanshi-info catalog-kanshi-info">' +
              '<div class="kanshi-main">' +
                '<span class="kanshi-name catalog-kanshi-name"></span>' +
                '<span class="kanshi-yomi catalog-kanshi-yomi"></span>' +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="kanshi-grid">' +
                '<div><span>十干</span><strong class="catalog-stem"></strong></div>' +
                '<div><span>十二支</span><strong class="catalog-branch"></strong></div>' +
                '<div><span>五行</span><strong class="catalog-element"></strong></div>' +
                '<div><span>陰陽</span><strong class="catalog-yinyang"></strong></div>' +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="catalog-question"></div>' +
            '<div class="catalog-hint"></div>' +
            '<h3 class="lucky-title">今日のラッキー項目</h3>' +
            '<table class="catalog-lucky"><tbody>' +
              '<tr><th>ラッキーカラー</th><td class="lc"></td></tr>' +
              '<tr><th>ラッキーアイテム</th><td class="li"></td></tr>' +
              '<tr><th>ラッキー遊具</th><td class="lp"></td></tr>' +
              '<tr><th>ラッキーレク</th><td class="lr"></td></tr>' +
            '</tbody></table>';
          text.querySelector(".catalog-kanshi-name").textContent = data.displayName;
          text.querySelector(".catalog-kanshi-yomi").textContent = data.yomi;
          text.querySelector(".catalog-stem").textContent = data.stem.char;
          text.querySelector(".catalog-branch").textContent = data.branch.char;
          text.querySelector(".catalog-element").textContent = data.stem.element;
          text.querySelector(".catalog-yinyang").textContent = data.stem.yinYang;
          text.querySelector(".catalog-question").textContent = data.question;
          text.querySelector(".catalog-hint").textContent = data.dailyHint;
          text.querySelector(".lc").textContent = data.luckyColor;
          text.querySelector(".li").textContent = data.luckyItem;
          text.querySelector(".lp").textContent = data.luckyPlayground;
          text.querySelector(".lr").textContent = data.luckyRec;
        }
      }

      const loadNewImage = () => {
        setText();
        if(catalogMode === "companion"){
          const card = companionCards[catalogIndex];
          const targetNo = card && card.no ? card.no : no;
          loadImageInto(img, "nakama", targetNo, () => {
            if(animate){
              img.classList.remove("slide-in-next","slide-in-prev");
              void img.offsetWidth;
              img.classList.add(direction > 0 ? "slide-in-next" : "slide-in-prev");
              setTimeout(() => {
                img.classList.remove("slide-in-next","slide-in-prev");
                catalogAnimating = false;
              }, 300);
            }else{
              catalogAnimating = false;
            }
          });
        }else{
          loadImageInto(img, "kanshi", no, () => {
            if(animate){
              img.classList.remove("slide-in-next","slide-in-prev");
              void img.offsetWidth;
              img.classList.add(direction > 0 ? "slide-in-next" : "slide-in-prev");
              setTimeout(() => {
                img.classList.remove("slide-in-next","slide-in-prev");
                catalogAnimating = false;
              }, 300);
            }else{
              catalogAnimating = false;
            }
          });
        }
      };

      if(!animate){
        catalogAnimating = false;
        loadNewImage();
        return;
      }

      catalogAnimating = true;
      img.classList.remove("slide-out-next","slide-out-prev","slide-in-next","slide-in-prev");
      void img.offsetWidth;
      img.classList.add(direction > 0 ? "slide-out-next" : "slide-out-prev");
      setTimeout(() => {
        img.classList.remove("slide-out-next","slide-out-prev");
        loadNewImage();
      }, 220);
    }

    function bindCatalogGestures(){
      const stage = document.getElementById("catalogCardStage");
      const viewport = document.getElementById("catalogCardViewport");
      if(!stage || stage.dataset.bound === "1") return;
      stage.dataset.bound = "1";

      stage.addEventListener("touchstart", e => {
        if(!e.touches || !e.touches.length) return;
        catalogTouchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        catalogTouchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      }, {passive:true});

      stage.addEventListener("touchend", e => {
        if(catalogTouchStartX === null || !e.changedTouches || !e.changedTouches.length) return;
        const dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - catalogTouchStartX;
        const dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - catalogTouchStartY;
        catalogTouchStartX = null;
        catalogTouchStartY = null;

        if(Math.abs(dx) > 45 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.15){
          // Natural carousel behavior:
          // left swipe  = next card
          // right swipe = previous card
          navigateCatalog(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1);
        }
      }, {passive:true});

      viewport.addEventListener("click", e => {
        if(catalogAnimating) return;
        const rect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
        navigateCatalog(x >= rect.width / 2 ? 1 : -1);
      });
    }

    function loadCompanionRevealImage(imgEl, no, onReady){
      const baseName = String(no).padStart(2,"0");
      const candidates = [
        `images/nakama/${baseName}_c.webp`,
        `images/nakama/${baseName}_c.png`,
        `images/nakama/${baseName}_c.jpg`,
        `images/nakama/${baseName}_c.jpeg`
      ];
      let index = 0;

      function fallbackToNormal(){
        loadImageInto(imgEl, "nakama", no, onReady);
      }

      function tryNext(){
        if(index >= candidates.length){
          fallbackToNormal();
          return;
        }
        imgEl.onload = function(){
          if(onReady) onReady(true);
        };
        imgEl.onerror = function(){
          index++;
          tryNext();
        };
        imgEl.src = resolveAsset(candidates[index]);
      }
      tryNext();
    }

    function loadCardImage(no, onReady){
      const resultImg = document.getElementById("resultMainImage");
      const flipImg = document.getElementById("cardMainImage");
      const fallback = document.getElementById("cardImageFallback");

      loadImageInto(resultImg, "kanshi", no, function(){
        if(flipImg){
          flipImg.onload = function(){
            flipImg.hidden = false;
            if(fallback) fallback.style.display = "none";
            if(onReady) onReady();
          };
          flipImg.onerror = function(){
            flipImg.hidden = true;
            if(fallback) fallback.style.display = "";
            if(onReady) onReady();
          };
          flipImg.src = resultImg.src;
        }else{
          if(onReady) onReady();
        }
      });
    }


    function loadCardBackImage(){
      const img = document.getElementById("cardBackImage");
      const back = document.querySelector(".face.back");
      const wrap = document.querySelector(".card-wrap");
      if(!img || !back) return;

      const candidates = [
        "images/common/card-back.webp",
        "images/common/card-back.png",
        "images/common/card-back.jpg",
        "images/common/card-back.jpeg"
      ];
      let index = 0;

      function tryNext(){
        if(index >= candidates.length){
          img.hidden = true;
          back.classList.remove("has-back-image");
          if(wrap){
            wrap.classList.remove("custom-back-loaded");
            wrap.classList.remove("showing-front");
          }
          return;
        }
        img.onload = function(){
          img.hidden = false;
          back.classList.add("has-back-image");
          if(wrap){
            wrap.classList.add("custom-back-loaded");
            wrap.classList.remove("showing-front");
          }
        };
        img.onerror = function(){
          index++;
          tryNext();
        };
        img.src = resolveAsset(candidates[index]);
      }
      tryNext();
    }

    function getCompanionInfo(no){
      const found = companionCards.find(card => Number(card.no) === Number(no));
      if(found) return found;

      const n = String(no).padStart(2,"0");
      return {
        no:Number(no),
        name:"仲間カード " + n,
        line:"「仲間のセリフが未設定です。」",
        effect:"カードの効果が未設定です。"
      };
    }

    function showCompanionInfo(no){
      const info = getCompanionInfo(no);
      const lineHero = document.getElementById("companionLineHero");
      const panel = document.getElementById("companionInfoPanel");
      const name = document.getElementById("companionName");
      const line = document.getElementById("companionLine");
      const effect = document.getElementById("companionEffect");

      if(name) name.textContent = info.name;
      if(line) line.textContent = info.line;
      if(effect) effect.textContent = info.effect;
      if(lineHero) lineHero.hidden = false;
      if(panel) panel.hidden = false;
    }

    function hideCompanionInfo(){
      const lineHero = document.getElementById("companionLineHero");
      const panel = document.getElementById("companionInfoPanel");
      if(lineHero) lineHero.hidden = true;
      if(panel) panel.hidden = true;
    }

    function scrollResultTextToTop(){
      const scroller = document.querySelector(".result-scroll");
      if(!scroller) return;

      const resetToTop = () => {
        scroller.scrollTop = 0;
        if(typeof scroller.scrollTo === "function"){
          scroller.scrollTo({ top:0, left:0, behavior:"auto" });
        }
      };

      // 画面が非表示→表示になるタイミングでも確実に先頭へ戻す
      resetToTop();
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        resetToTop();
        requestAnimationFrame(resetToTop);
      });
      setTimeout(resetToTop, 80);
    }

    function drawCompanion(){
      if(companionDrawn || !currentMainCard) return;

      companionDrawn = true;
      const btn = document.getElementById("companionBtn");
      if(btn){
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = "仲間カードを選んでいます…";
      }

      if(companionCards.length === 0){
        companionDrawn = false;
        if(btn){
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = "仲間カードデータがありません";
        }
        return;
      }

      companionCardData = companionCards[Math.floor(Math.random() * companionCards.length)];

      const revealImg = document.getElementById("companionRevealImage");
      const topCompanionImg = document.getElementById("companionMainImage");
      const overlay = document.getElementById("companionOverlay");
      const cardEl = document.getElementById("companionCard");

      loadCompanionRevealImage(revealImg, companionCardData.no, (ok) => {
        loadImageInto(topCompanionImg, "nakama", companionCardData.no);
        topCompanionImg.alt = companionCardData.name || ("仲間カード " + String(companionCardData.no).padStart(2,"0"));

        // Start from center
        cardEl.removeAttribute("style");
        cardEl.classList.remove("reveal");
        overlay.classList.add("show");

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            cardEl.classList.add("reveal");

            // Pause briefly at center, then fly to the top card slot
            setTimeout(() => {
              const target = document.getElementById("resultCardFrame");
              if(!target) return;

              const start = cardEl.getBoundingClientRect();
              const end = target.getBoundingClientRect();

              cardEl.style.position = "fixed";
              cardEl.style.top = start.top + "px";
              cardEl.style.left = start.left + "px";
              cardEl.style.width = start.width + "px";
              cardEl.style.height = start.height + "px";
              cardEl.style.margin = "0";
              cardEl.style.transform = "scale(1) rotateY(0deg)";
              cardEl.style.opacity = "1";

              requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                cardEl.style.top = end.top + "px";
                cardEl.style.left = end.left + "px";
                cardEl.style.width = end.width + "px";
                cardEl.style.height = end.height + "px";

                setTimeout(() => {
                  overlay.classList.remove("show");
                  cardEl.classList.remove("reveal");
                  cardEl.removeAttribute("style");

                  showingCompanion = true;
                  const flipper = document.getElementById("topCardFlipper");
                  if(flipper) flipper.classList.add("flipped");
                  const hint = document.getElementById("companionHint");
                  if(hint) hint.hidden = false;
                  showCompanionInfo(companionCardData.no);
                  scrollResultTextToTop();
                  if(btn) btn.textContent = "仲間カードを引きました";
                }, 660);
              });
            }, 700);
          });
        });
      });
    }

    function toggleTopCard(){
      if(!companionDrawn || !companionCardData) return false;

      const flipper = document.getElementById("topCardFlipper");
      if(!flipper) return false;

      showingCompanion = !showingCompanion;
      if(showingCompanion){
        flipper.classList.add("flipped");
      }else{
        flipper.classList.remove("flipped");
      }
      return false;
    }

    function animateCardToResult(){
      const stageCard = document.querySelector(".card-wrap");
      const sourceImg = document.getElementById("resultMainImage");
      const stageEl = document.querySelector(".stage");
      const screen = document.getElementById("resultScreen");

      if(!stageCard || !sourceImg || !screen){
        if(screen) screen.classList.add("show");
        document.body.classList.add("result-mode");
        scrollResultTextToTop();
        return;
      }

      const rect = stageCard.getBoundingClientRect();
      const ghost = document.createElement("div");
      ghost.className = "transition-card";
      ghost.style.top = rect.top + "px";
      ghost.style.left = rect.left + "px";
      ghost.style.width = rect.width + "px";
      ghost.style.height = rect.height + "px";

      const img = document.createElement("img");
      img.src = sourceImg.src || "";
      img.alt = "";
      ghost.appendChild(img);
      document.body.appendChild(ghost);

      if(stageEl) stageEl.classList.add("transitioning");

      screen.classList.add("show");
      document.body.classList.add("result-mode");
      scrollResultTextToTop();

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          const target = document.querySelector(".result-card-frame");
          if(!target) return;
          const t = target.getBoundingClientRect();

          ghost.style.top = t.top + "px";
          ghost.style.left = t.left + "px";
          ghost.style.width = t.width + "px";
          ghost.style.height = t.height + "px";

          setTimeout(() => {
            ghost.style.opacity = "0";
            setTimeout(() => {
              ghost.remove();
              if(stageEl) stageEl.classList.remove("transitioning");
            }, 220);
          }, 620);
        });
      });
    }


    const YEAR_PICKER_MIN = 1900;
    const YEAR_PICKER_MAX = 2100;
    const YEAR_PICKER_BASE_YEAR = 1984; // 甲子
    const YEAR_WHEEL_ITEM_HEIGHT = 52;
    let selectedFortuneYear = Math.max(
      YEAR_PICKER_MIN,
      Math.min(YEAR_PICKER_MAX, new Date().getFullYear())
    );
    let yearPickerScrollTimer = null;
    let yearPickerInitializing = false;

    function kanshiIndexForYear(year){
      return ((year - YEAR_PICKER_BASE_YEAR) % 60 + 60) % 60;
    }

    function kanshiForYear(year){
      return allKanshi[kanshiIndexForYear(year)];
    }

    function buildYearPicker(){
      const wheel = document.getElementById("yearWheel");
      if(!wheel || wheel.dataset.ready === "1") return;

      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for(let year = YEAR_PICKER_MIN; year <= YEAR_PICKER_MAX; year++){
        const data = kanshiForYear(year);
        const item = document.createElement("div");
        item.className = "year-wheel-item";
        item.dataset.year = String(year);
        item.setAttribute("role","option");
        item.setAttribute("aria-label", year + "年 " + data.name);
        item.innerHTML =
          '<span class="year">' + year + '年</span>' +
          '<span class="kanshi">' + data.name + '</span>';
        item.addEventListener("click", () => {
          selectedFortuneYear = year;
          scrollYearIntoCenter(year, true);
        });
        frag.appendChild(item);
      }
      wheel.appendChild(frag);
      wheel.dataset.ready = "1";

      wheel.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
        if(yearPickerInitializing) return;
        updateYearSelectionFromScroll();
        clearTimeout(yearPickerScrollTimer);
        yearPickerScrollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          scrollYearIntoCenter(selectedFortuneYear, true);
        }, 90);
      }, {passive:true});
    }

    function yearToWheelIndex(year){
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(YEAR_PICKER_MAX - YEAR_PICKER_MIN, year - YEAR_PICKER_MIN));
    }

    function scrollYearIntoCenter(year, smooth){
      const wheel = document.getElementById("yearWheel");
      if(!wheel) return;
      const index = yearToWheelIndex(year);
      wheel.scrollTo({
        top:index * YEAR_WHEEL_ITEM_HEIGHT,
        behavior:smooth ? "smooth" : "auto"
      });
      selectedFortuneYear = YEAR_PICKER_MIN + index;
      updateYearPickerVisuals();
    }

    function updateYearSelectionFromScroll(){
      const wheel = document.getElementById("yearWheel");
      if(!wheel) return;
      const index = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(
          YEAR_PICKER_MAX - YEAR_PICKER_MIN,
          Math.round(wheel.scrollTop / YEAR_WHEEL_ITEM_HEIGHT)
        )
      );
      selectedFortuneYear = YEAR_PICKER_MIN + index;
      updateYearPickerVisuals();
    }

    function updateYearPickerVisuals(){
      const selectedIndex = yearToWheelIndex(selectedFortuneYear);
      const items = document.querySelectorAll(".year-wheel-item");
      items.forEach((item, idx) => {
        item.classList.toggle("selected", idx === selectedIndex);
        item.classList.toggle("near", Math.abs(idx - selectedIndex) === 1);
        item.setAttribute("aria-selected", idx === selectedIndex ? "true" : "false");
      });

      const selectedData = kanshiForYear(selectedFortuneYear);
      const yearText = document.getElementById("selectedYearText");
      const kanshiText = document.getElementById("selectedKanshiText");
      if(yearText) yearText.textContent = selectedFortuneYear + "年";
      if(kanshiText) kanshiText.textContent = selectedData.name;
    }

    function openYearPicker(){
      if(drawing) return false;

      scrollResultTextToTop();
      yearPickerInitializing = true;
      buildYearPicker();

      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      selectedFortuneYear = Math.max(
        YEAR_PICKER_MIN,
        Math.min(YEAR_PICKER_MAX, currentYear)
      );

      const screen = document.getElementById("yearPickerScreen");
      const wheel = document.getElementById("yearWheel");

      if(screen){
        screen.classList.add("show");
        screen.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
      }
      document.body.classList.add("year-picker-mode");

      updateYearPickerVisuals();

      const placeOnCurrentYear = () => {
        if(!wheel) return;
        const index = yearToWheelIndex(selectedFortuneYear);
        wheel.scrollTop = index * YEAR_WHEEL_ITEM_HEIGHT;
        updateYearPickerVisuals();
      };

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          placeOnCurrentYear();

          setTimeout(() => {
            placeOnCurrentYear();
            yearPickerInitializing = false;
          }, 80);
        });
      });

      return false;
    }

    function closeYearPicker(){
      const screen = document.getElementById("yearPickerScreen");
      if(screen){
        screen.classList.remove("show");
        screen.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
      }
      document.body.classList.remove("year-picker-mode");
      return false;
    }

    function confirmYearSelection(){
      const data = kanshiForYear(selectedFortuneYear);
      closeYearPicker();
      drawSpecificCard(data);
      return false;
    }

    function drawSpecificCard(data){
      if(drawing || !data) return;
      hideCompanionInfo();
      scrollResultTextToTop();
      drawing = true;
      drawBtn.disabled = true;
      const yearBtn = document.getElementById("yearFortuneBtn");
      if(yearBtn) yearBtn.disabled = true;
      result.classList.remove("show");

      card.classList.remove("flipped");

      setTimeout(() => {
        renderCard(data, () => {
          const stageWrap = document.querySelector(".card-wrap");
          if(stageWrap) stageWrap.classList.add("showing-front");
          card.classList.add("flipped");

          setTimeout(() => {
            animateCardToResult();
            drawBtn.disabled = false;
            if(yearBtn) yearBtn.disabled = false;
            drawing = false;
          }, 700);
        });
      }, 420);
    }

    function draw(){
      if(drawing) return;
      hideCompanionInfo();
      scrollResultTextToTop();
      drawing = true;
      drawBtn.disabled = true;
      const yearBtn = document.getElementById("yearFortuneBtn");
      if(yearBtn) yearBtn.disabled = true;
      result.classList.remove("show");

      card.classList.remove("flipped");

      setTimeout(() => {
        const data = allKanshi[Math.floor(Math.random()*allKanshi.length)];
        renderCard(data, () => {
          const stageWrap = document.querySelector(".card-wrap");
          if(stageWrap) stageWrap.classList.add("showing-front");
          card.classList.add("flipped");

          setTimeout(() => {
            animateCardToResult();
            drawBtn.disabled = false;
            if(yearBtn) yearBtn.disabled = false;
            drawing = false;
          }, 700);
        });
      }, 420);
    }

    function returnToStart(){
      document.querySelectorAll(".transition-card").forEach(el => el.remove());
      const stageEl = document.querySelector(".stage");
      if(stageEl) stageEl.classList.remove("transitioning");
      const screen = document.getElementById("resultScreen");
      if(screen) screen.classList.remove("show");
      document.body.classList.remove("result-mode");
      document.documentElement.style.overflow = "";
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
      card.classList.remove("flipped");
      const stageWrap = document.querySelector(".card-wrap");
      if(stageWrap) stageWrap.classList.remove("showing-front");
      companionDrawn = false;
      companionCardData = null;
      showingCompanion = false;
      const flipper = document.getElementById("topCardFlipper");
      if(flipper) flipper.classList.remove("flipped");
      const hint = document.getElementById("companionHint");
      if(hint) hint.hidden = true;
      hideCompanionInfo();
      const companionBtn = document.getElementById("companionBtn");
      if(companionBtn){
        companionBtn.disabled = false;
        companionBtn.textContent = "仲間カードを引く";
      }
      drawBtn.hidden = false;
      drawBtn.disabled = false;
      const yearBtn = document.getElementById("yearFortuneBtn");
      if(yearBtn){
        yearBtn.hidden = false;
        yearBtn.disabled = false;
      }
      closeYearPicker();
      resetBtn.hidden = true;
      scrollResultTextToTop();
      window.scrollTo(0,0);
      return false;
    }

    function reset(){
      return returnToStart();
    }

    updateYearPickerVisuals();

    const homeCardWrap = document.getElementById("homeCardWrap");
    if(homeCardWrap){
      homeCardWrap.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if(e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " "){
          e.preventDefault();
          handleHomeCardTap();
        }
      });
    }
    loadCardBackImage();

    drawBtn.addEventListener("click", draw);
    resetBtn.addEventListener("click", reset);
    const backBtn = document.getElementById("backToTopBtn");
    if(backBtn) backBtn.addEventListener("click", returnToStart);
  </script>

  <section class="result-screen" id="resultScreen" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="result-top">
      <div class="result-card-frame" id="resultCardFrame" onclick="toggleTopCard()" title="仲間カードを引いた後はタップで切り替え">
        <div class="top-card-flipper" id="topCardFlipper">
          <div class="top-card-face front-face">
            <img id="resultMainImage" alt="最初に引いた六十干支カード">
          </div>
          <div class="top-card-face back-face">
            <img id="companionMainImage" alt="仲間カード">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="companion-hint" id="companionHint" hidden>カード画像をタップすると、最初のカードと仲間カードが入れ替わります。</div>
    </div>
    <div class="result-scroll">
      <div class="companion-line-hero" id="companionLineHero" hidden>
        <div id="companionLine">―</div>
      </div>

      <div class="companion-info-panel" id="companionInfoPanel" hidden>
        <div class="companion-info-row companion-info-row-no-label">
          <div class="companion-info-value companion-name-value" id="companionName">―</div>
        </div>
        <div class="companion-info-row companion-info-row-no-label">
          <div class="companion-info-value companion-effect-value" id="companionEffect">―</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="result-scroll-inner">
        <div class="kanshi-info">
          <div class="kanshi-main">
            <span class="kanshi-name" id="infoKanshi">甲子</span>
            <span class="kanshi-yomi" id="infoYomi">きのえね</span>
          </div>
          <div class="kanshi-grid">
            <div><span>十干</span><strong id="infoStem">甲</strong></div>
            <div><span>十二支</span><strong id="infoBranch">子</strong></div>
            <div><span>五行</span><strong id="infoElement">木</strong></div>
            <div><span>陰陽</span><strong id="infoYinYang">陽</strong></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="question-panel question-panel-emphasis">
          <p id="todayQuestion"></p>
        </div>

        <div class="message-section message-section-no-label">
          <p class="daily-hint" id="dailyHint"></p>
        </div>

        <h3 class="lucky-title">今日のラッキー項目</h3>
        <table class="lucky-table">
          <tbody>
            <tr><th>ラッキーカラー</th><td id="luckyColor"></td></tr>
            <tr><th>ラッキーアイテム</th><td id="luckyItem"></td></tr>
            <tr><th>ラッキー遊具</th><td id="luckyPlayground"></td></tr>
            <tr><th>ラッキーレク</th><td id="luckyRec"></td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <div class="result-back-row" style="gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <button class="primary" id="companionBtn" type="button" onclick="drawCompanion()">仲間カードを引く</button>
          <button class="secondary" id="backToTopBtn" type="button" onclick="returnToStart()">戻る</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>


  <div class="companion-overlay" id="companionOverlay">
    <div class="companion-card" id="companionCard">
      <img id="companionRevealImage" alt="仲間カード">
    </div>
  </div>





<script>
if ("serviceWorker" in navigator) {
  window.addEventListener("load", () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register("./service-worker.js").catch(() => {});
  });
}
</script>

</body>
</html>
